info.title: Effective departures and scoped exit archives
info.description: V29 is preparation only. V34 effective facts gate current business. Exit ZIP inventories cover chosen authorized shared material versions and independent experience only; never attest full-tenant migration. Private bodies remain private. Temporary archives are bounded and physically removed at fixed expiry.
